+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# post-merge.yml's reporting (#1451): one rolling issue "main is red
+# (post-merge gate)". Red: open it, or comment on the open one, with the
+# failing suites, the head sha and the run URL. Green: comment the green sha
+# and close it. Never one issue per run.
+# Inputs (env): STATUS (success|failure), SHA, RUN_URL, REPO, OUTPUT (the
+# gate's stdout file), GH (gh binary override, tests use a fake).
+# Priority (AGENTS.md "Priorities", P1..P9): a red gate on main is P2; it is
+# P1 (wrong output) only when a failing suite is one of OUTPUT_SUITES below,
+# the suites whose job is to compare posted NC or CL output with a golden or
+# recorded stream. A compile error, a lathe/sim/motion law or a post-crate
+# unit (lib) test stays P2. An open P2 issue is raised to P1 when a later run
+# fails an output suite; it is never lowered here (a human does that).
+# Provenance: our own AGENTS.md "Issue Law"; GitHub's public gh CLI docs.
+set -uo pipefail
+gh_bin="${GH:-gh}"
+repo="${REPO:?REPO is required}"
+sha="${SHA:?SHA is required}"
+title="main is red (post-merge gate)"
+short="${sha:0:10}"
+
+# Whole test-binary names (the stem of tests/<name>.rs), matched anchored,
+# never as substrings: "compost" or a "post suites" step note does not match.
+# Taken from the batch tier's plan (cargo xtask gate batch --dry-run): app's
+# golden CL/NC suites and posted-output suites, post's recorded-stream and
+# per-dialect golden suites (script_<dialect>).
+OUTPUT_SUITES='^(golden_cl|solid_law_goldens|recorded_post_streams|recorded_streams|posting|post_engine|post_cycle_feed_spindle|carvera_post|grblhal_post|lathe_post|lathe_post_css|lathe_post_g76|lathe_post_inch|lathe_post_tormach|lathe_post_tormach_thread|plasma_post|tinyg_post|tormach_post|wire_post|fanuc_post|doosan_dnm_post|inverted_post|script_[a-z0-9_]+)$'
+
+# Only an agent-filed issue (source:agent) is ever commented on or closed here;
+# a human-filed issue with the same title is left alone.
+open=$("$gh_bin" issue list -R "$repo" --state open --label source:agent --search "\"$title\" in:title" \
+  --limit 20 --json number,title \
+  --jq "[.[] | select(.title == \"$title\")][0].number // empty") || open=""
+
+if [ "${STATUS:-}" = success ]; then
+  if [ -n "$open" ]; then
+    "$gh_bin" issue comment "$open" -R "$repo" --body "Green again: the post-merge batch gate passed on \`$sha\` (${RUN_URL:-no run url}). Closing; a new red run opens a new issue." || exit 1
+    "$gh_bin" issue close "$open" -R "$repo" --reason completed || exit 1
+    echo "closed #$open"
+  else
+    echo "green, no open red issue"
+  fi
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+# Failing steps: the gate summary's "  FAIL  <secs>s  <step>  <note>" rows.
+fails=$(sed -n '/^== gate summary/,$p' "${OUTPUT:-/dev/null}" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^ +FAIL ' | head -40 || true)
+[ -n "$fails" ] || fails="(no FAIL row in the gate summary: the gate did not finish or failed to build; see the run)"
+# The FAIL rows' notes read "failed: tests/<name>.rs, ..." (xtask exec.rs read_log,
+# which prints cargo's "Running <path>"); a directory suite reads tests/<name>/main.rs.
+suites=$(printf '%s\n' "$fails" | grep -oE 'tests/[A-Za-z0-9_]+(/main)?\.rs' | sed -e 's#^tests/##' -e 's#\.rs$##' -e 's#/main$##' | sort -u || true)
+out_hit=$(printf '%s\n' "$suites" | grep -E "$OUTPUT_SUITES" || true)
+
+body=$(printf 'The post-merge batch gate failed on `%s`.\n\nRun: %s\n\nFailing steps:\n```\n%s\n```\n\nThe merge that broke it is among the commits up to this head (`git log` since the last green run). Fix it in the normal order; this issue closes itself on the next green run.\n' \
+  "$sha" "${RUN_URL:-no run url}" "$fails")
+
+if [ -n "$open" ]; then
+  "$gh_bin" issue comment "$open" -R "$repo" --body "Still red on \`$short\` (${RUN_URL:-no run url}).
+
+Failing steps:
+\`\`\`
+$fails
+\`\`\`" || exit 1
+  if [ -n "$out_hit" ]; then
+    "$gh_bin" issue edit "$open" -R "$repo" --add-label P1 --remove-label P2 || exit 1
+  fi
+  echo "commented on #$open"
+else
+  prio=P2; [ -n "$out_hit" ] && prio=P1
+  "$gh_bin" issue create -R "$repo" --title "$title" \
+    --label "$prio" --label source:agent --label effort:low --label area:build \
+    --body "$body" || exit 1
+fi

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# post-merge.yml's yield rule (#1451): exit 0 and print the reason when the
+# post-merge batch gate should step aside for a cut, exit 1 (silent) when it
+# should run. Uses only `gh` read calls (actions: read, pull-requests: read).
+# Provenance: our own AGENTS.md "The cut runner"; GitHub's public gh CLI docs.
+# GH overrides the gh binary (tests use a fake).
+set -uo pipefail
+gh_bin="${GH:-gh}"
+repo="${REPO:?REPO is required}"
+
+running=$("$gh_bin" run list -R "$repo" --workflow cut.yml --status in_progress --limit 5 \
+  --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId // empty') || running=""
+if [ -z "$running" ]; then
+  running=$("$gh_bin" run list -R "$repo" --workflow cut.yml --status queued --limit 5 \
+    --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId // empty') || running=""
+fi
+if [ -n "$running" ]; then
+  echo "a cut.yml run ($running) is using the runner"
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+# An open release PR from this repo's own release/vX.Y.Z branch: a cut is
+# between "release branch" and "tag", and its gate or tag job is about to
+# need the runner. A fork's PR branch of the same name does not count.
+rel=$("$gh_bin" pr list -R "$repo" --state open --limit 100 \
+  --json headRefName,isCrossRepository \
+  --jq '[.[] | select((.isCrossRepository | not) and (.headRefName | test("^release/v")))][0].headRefName // empty') || rel=""
+if [ -n "$rel" ]; then
+  echo "release PR branch $rel is open (a cut is in progress)"
+  exit 0
+fi
+exit 1

+# Post-merge gate (#1451): the batch tier of the gate, run on the self-hosted
+# Linux runner after every push to main, instead of a gate-runner agent in the
+# maintainer's checkout (AGENTS.md "Fixes are tested in the background").
+# Triggers: push to main, and workflow_dispatch (input ref). Never
+# pull_request, pull_request_target or schedule (maintainer, 2026-11-13: "Can
+# we setup a build test post merge using local gh runner?"; a push to main
+# only carries merged, reviewed code, so no fork can run code on the runner).
+# Sharing the one runner with the cut: this workflow yields. A burst of merges
+# tests only the newest head (cancel-in-progress), and a run skips itself
+# (green, with a notice) while a cut.yml run is queued or running or a
+# release/vX.Y.Z PR from this repo is open (.github/scripts/post-merge-skip.sh).
+# The release gate of the cut covers main's state then. A cut therefore never
+# queues behind more than the one post-merge run that was already going.
+# Reporting: one rolling issue "main is red (post-merge gate)", opened or
+# commented on when red, closed when green (.github/scripts/post-merge-report.sh).
+# Only the report job holds issues: write; the gate job's token is read-only
+# and is never left on disk while the tests run (persist-credentials: false).
+# Provenance: our own AGENTS.md; GitHub's public Actions documentation.
+name: Post-merge gate
+run-name: post-merge gate ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      ref:
+        description: 'Branch, tag or sha to gate (default: main). A non-main ref reports nothing to the rolling issue'
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+
+env:
+  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+# A dispatch of a non-main ref gets its own group, so it never cancels (or is
+# cancelled by) the gate of main.
+concurrency:
+  group: post-merge-${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 'main' || inputs.ref || 'main' }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  gate:
+    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux]
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      actions: read
+      pull-requests: read
+    outputs:
+      skipped: ${{ steps.yield.outputs.skip }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Yield to a cut
+        id: yield
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
+        run: |
+          if reason=$(bash .github/scripts/post-merge-skip.sh); then
+            echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+            echo "::notice title=post-merge gate skipped::$reason; the cut's release gate covers main"
+            echo "Skipped: $reason." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          else
+            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          fi
+      - name: Batch gate tier
+        if: ${{ steps.yield.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
+        shell: bash
+        # The UI suites open windows: inside xvfb-run when no display is set
+        # (AGENTS.md "The cut runner"). sccache comes from the runner's
+        # environment. No token is in this step's environment.
+        run: |
+          set -o pipefail
+          wrap=()
+          if [ -z "${DISPLAY:-}" ] && [ -z "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ] && command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null; then
+            wrap=(xvfb-run -a)
+          fi
+          echo "${wrap[*]} cargo xtask gate batch"
+          "${wrap[@]}" cargo xtask gate batch 2>&1 | tee gate-output.txt
+      - name: Gate summary
+        if: ${{ always() && steps.yield.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          {
+            echo "### Post-merge batch gate at $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+            echo '```'
+            sed -n '/^== gate summary/,$p' gate-output.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "no gate output"
+            echo '```'
+          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+      - name: Gate logs
+        if: ${{ always() && steps.yield.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: gate-logs-post-merge-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: |
+            gate-logs/
+            gate-output.txt
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+
+  report:
+    # Red or green only: a cancelled run (a newer merge) or a skipped one says nothing.
+    needs: gate
+    if: ${{ (needs.gate.result == 'success' || needs.gate.result == 'failure') && needs.gate.outputs.skipped != 'true' && (github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.ref == '' || inputs.ref == 'main') }}
+    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux]
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      issues: write
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        continue-on-error: true
+        with:
+          name: gate-logs-post-merge-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: gate-report
+      - name: Rolling main-is-red issue
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
+          STATUS: ${{ needs.gate.result }}
+          SHA: ${{ inputs.ref && inputs.ref != 'main' && inputs.ref || github.sha }}
+          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
+          OUTPUT: gate-report/gate-output.txt
+        run: bash .github/scripts/post-merge-report.sh

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+# 1451 - post-merge batch gate on the self-hosted runner
+
+- **Yield rule: skip when a cut.yml run is queued/running or a same-repo release/v* PR is open.**
+  Why: simplest rule that cannot starve a cut on a one-runner pool; the release
+  gate of the cut re-tests main anyway. Dropped: job priorities (GitHub has
+  none for self-hosted queues), a second runner label (more setup), waiting
+  in-job (would hold the runner).
+  Cost: merges landing during a cut are not post-merge tested; the cut gate covers them.
+- **Reporting: one rolling issue, P2 by default, P1 only when a failing suite
+  is a wrong-output suite.** AGENTS.md "Priorities" (P1..P9, P0 retired) puts
+  "a gate on main is red" at P2 and wrong posted output at P1; AGENTS.md
+  governs over the issue's wording, which asked for P1/P0. P0 is never used.
+  The wrong-output suites are an explicit, anchored list of whole test-binary
+  names in the script (`OUTPUT_SUITES`: golden_cl, solid_law_goldens,
+  recorded_post_streams, recorded_streams, the `*_post` NC golden suites,
+  post's `script_<dialect>` suites, ...), read from the FAIL rows' "failed:
+  tests/<name>.rs" notes. Dropped: a substring match on golden|gcode|post
+  (caught the whole post crate step and words like "compost"). An open P2
+  issue is raised to P1 by a later output-suite red, never lowered by the
+  script. Closed by the next green run; cancelled/skipped runs say nothing.
+- **Only `source:agent` issues are found, commented on and closed**, so a
+  green run never closes a human-filed issue with the same title.
+- **Concurrency group per ref:** a dispatch of a non-main ref runs in its own
+  group and never cancels main's gate.
+- **Reporting logic lives in `.github/scripts/*.sh`**, testable with a fake gh,
+  not inline YAML.
+- **Token scope:** gate job read-only (`persist-credentials: false`, token only in the
+  yield step); only the report job has `issues: write`.
+- **PROCESS_VERSION 61** (upstream main was 60; #1418 also bumps - settled at merge).
